changelog:
# Stock-analysis v1.0.0

Redesigned as an AI-powered analytical tool distilling the styles of five major WeChat stock-investing influencers, with a focus on multi-mode, style-driven investment analysis.

- distilled and structured over 200 articles from 5 key WeChat influencers into JSON style profiles for AI-driven analysis
- supports single- or multi-influencer (大V) analysis, daily/sector recaps, stock screening, portfolio review, earnings commentary, and view tracking across multiple analytical modes
- integrates real-time market data via web search, ensuring all price/flow numbers are sourced and labeled (prohibits generated/guessed data)
- enforces multi-phase execution with user-involved article syncing, environmental sanity checks, data source cross-verification, quality audits, and incremental style profile updates
- output always discloses data sources and simulation nature, with built-in compliance and audit rules to prevent misleading or financial advice

> Previous versions/commands/features have been fully replaced by the new influencer style analysis framework.
display_name: 股票分析专家-公众号股票大V蒸馏
